rows.result: accepted bounded conventional recast, moderate confidence
rows.reason: The newly confirmed whole Feltoe prayer already fixes acceptance of offered gifts, sanctification, and salvation for the same speakers in the same sequence. Gifts/offerings is a conventional object designation; removal of offered avoids redundancy; neuter forms follow that noun; grant-them-to-be-salutary recasts the same result without new predicate content. Read together these are ordinary revisions of one complete composition, not a selection of independent imagery or petitions.
rows.contrary: Munera nostra and the terminal indirect statement remain deliberate stylistic choices and could be alleged to meet the low originality threshold. Acceptance is limited to this exact expression with a separately governed conclusion; no general synonym-replacement rule follows.
rows.english: Faithful: gracious reception, our gifts, divine sanctification, request marker, and salvation for us remain. English coordinates the Latin relative clause idiomatically without adding a distinct request.
rows.conclusion_finding: Whole prayer and actual PerChristum cue reviewed against same secondary2002 artifact. IGMR77 AP22 supplies short Father formula and separate Amen. Full historical formula/response independently read Lasance217. Old cue remains evidence and is not silently expanded.

rows.result: accepted bounded single-prayer condensation, lower confidence
rows.reason: The old prayer already expressly juxtaposes creatures made for frailty with their sacrament-of-eternity result. The removed dedication description and repeated present-life assistance do not supply the modern contrast: that expression is retained from the old composition. Grammatical repair joins the surviving relationship without rearranging its conceptual sequence or introducing a new image, actor or requested result. This exact condensation is a defensible minor revision of that complete old expression.
rows.contrary: This is an internal abridgment, not the simple beginning/end deletion example of Compendium709.3. It deliberately removes a theological dedication clause and an express requested benefit, so a reasonable alternative assessment could regard the sharpened contrast as authored selection. This narrow source approval remains subject to Root’s final merits decision, never an assertion that all abridgments are unprotectable.
rows.english: Faithful: Lord our God, creation as support for weakness, potius as especially, explicit petition marker, etiam as also, beneficiary for us, and sacrament of eternity remain. Creatures has its traditional created-things sense; no animal-only meaning is asserted.
rows.conclusion_finding: Whole prayer and actual PerChristum cue reviewed against same secondary2002 artifact. IGMR77 AP22 supplies short Father formula and separate Amen. Full historical formula/response independently read Lasance217. Old cue remains evidence and is not silently expanded.

rows.result: accepted bounded conventional sacrificial designation, moderate confidence
rows.reason: The whole Gelasian prayer already fixes reception of the propitiatory sacrifice, cleansing by its operation, and the acceptable inward disposition offered to God. The independently old conventional designation placationis et laudis and a simple connective condense the opening without rebuilding that expressive movement. Praise is newly explicit relative to the main prayer, but functions here as a standard sacrificial attribute, not a newly developed petition or image. The remaining expression is already the old prayer.
rows.contrary: The shortening removes God’s expressed willingness and adds praise through a phrase selected from another old prayer; coordination can be original even when ingredients are public domain. Acceptance depends on this conventional descriptive function inside the exact unchanged larger sentence, not on phrase brevity or ancient vocabulary alone.
rows.english: Faithful: propitiation and praise retained; cleansed refers to the speakers; by its working points to the sacrifice; devotion of mind renders mentis affectum, with pleasing to you retained.
